description: SDPA forward in the ASM_SDPA_ENGINE region: bfloat16, head size 128 or 192 for Q and K with V and O at 128 (fmha_v3_fwd gfx942/gfx950 kernel tables), BSHD or BHSD, grouped-query heads, any sequence length, dense or bottom-right causal. gfx950 ships no causal kernel, so its causal samples decline; they stay as probes. The domain axis fills Q, K and V; large uses scale 8 instead of 32 so Q.K sums of a 192-wide head stay inside the half and bfloat16 range before the softmax scale. V keeps a smaller range than Q and K under wide (free(-2,2)) and large (scale 2): the kernel rounds P to bfloat16 for the P.V product, which errs by about 2^-9 per unit of |V| per term, and a cancelling sum leaves an output below that error, so atol 0.01 does not grade a V of magnitude 4 or more (probed on gfx950, Q and K wide or large: V in +-8 or large scale 8 fails 82 of 100 samples, V in +-4 fails 41 of 150, V in +-2 fails none of 150). The nan and inf domains put the special fill on V alone, 2^-12 of its elements, and leave Q and K at free(-1,1): a non-finite element of Q or K reaches a whole softmax row or every row, and the reference zeroes the output row of a NaN logit row where the kernel gives NaN (probed with a poisoned Q), while one in V reaches only its own head-dim column of the output; the sparse share keeps most columns finite, which the non-finite mask needs (it fails a reference with no finite element, so the earlier 5% share failed every long-kv sample by design). They poison only where the reference and the kernel agree and draw the default fill elsewhere: a causal sample (probed on Gfx950AttentionDense: NaN in the reference where the kernel is finite, as if the kernel never read the masked kv positions) and an infinity with a softmax scale above 1 (probed on Gfx950AttentionDense: inf in one and NaN in the other, as when P underflows to zero at different logit gaps and 0 * inf is NaN). The alignment axis declares that alignment on K, Q, O and V (uids 0, 1, 2, 3) through tensor_patches, and the placement axis puts the device pointers at exactly that alignment (exact) or misaligns Q (placement_uid 1) below it, a case that passes only if the backend rejects it (under, drawn as exact at alignment 1); default leaves the pointers where they are.

derive.stride_q: [sq*hq*dqk, dqk, hq*dqk, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dqk, sq*dqk, dqk, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*hkv*dqk, dqk, hkv*dqk, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dqk, skv*dqk, dqk, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*hkv*dv, dv, hkv*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*dv, skv*dv, dv, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*hq*dv, dv, hq*dv, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*dv, sq*dv, dv, 1]
derive.nf_ok: not causal and not (domain == 'inf' and (dtype == 'half' or scale > 1))
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if dom_poison else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive', 'nan', 'inf'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: bottom-right causal mask needs sq <= skv
